exampleSentences.en: The tenacious reporter spent years investigating the scandal.
exampleSentences.zh: 頑強的記者花了數年調查醜聞。

exampleSentences.en: Tenacious commitment to quality distinguishes market leaders.
exampleSentences.zh: 對品質的頑強承諾是市場領導者的區別。

tenacious.mnemonicHint: ten(hold) + acious → 緊緊抓住 → 頑強的

than that.chinese: 比那個……（不完整比較片段）

exampleSentences.en: This jacket costs less than that one in the window.
exampleSentences.zh: 這件外套比櫥窗裡那件便宜。

exampleSentences.en: The observed preference for remote work was stronger than that predicted by the initial model.
exampleSentences.zh: 實際觀察到的遠距工作偏好強於初始模型的預測。

than that.mnemonicHint: 這是被截斷的比較結構，不能單獨表意；自然句型要補成 comparative + than that one，或 than that predicted/observed。注意 than 是「比」，then 才是「然後」。

that i.chinese: 那是我……；我所……（不完整子句）

exampleSentences.en: That I forgot your birthday does not mean I do not care.
exampleSentences.zh: 我忘了你的生日並不表示我不在乎。

exampleSentences.en: The committee acknowledged that I had reported the discrepancy before the audit began.
exampleSentences.zh: 委員會承認我在稽核開始前就已通報該差異。

that i.mnemonicHint: 原片段缺少後續謂語，而且英文代名詞 I 永遠大寫；修正時寫成 that I + verb，或讓整個 That I + verb 子句充當主詞。

exampleSentences.en: Two cookies are mine; the others are for the children.
exampleSentences.zh: 兩塊餅乾是我的，其餘的是給孩子們的。

exampleSentences.en: Some participants chose buses, whereas the others favored rail transport.
exampleSentences.zh: 部分參與者選擇公車，其餘的人則偏好鐵路運輸。

the others.mnemonicHint: the 指已知範圍，others 指複數的「其餘者」；the others 就是特定群體中剩下的全部，不同於泛指某些其他人的 others。

exampleSentences.en: I have a theory about why the door keeps sticking.
exampleSentences.zh: 我有一個理論，可以解釋這扇門為何一直卡住。

exampleSentences.en: The theory predicts how markets respond to limited information.
exampleSentences.zh: 該理論預測市場如何回應有限資訊。

theory.mnemonicHint: theory 是用一套想法來觀看與解釋現象。

exampleSentences.en: I am thinking about making soup for dinner.
exampleSentences.zh: 我正在考慮晚餐煮湯。

exampleSentences.en: Critical thinking enables students to evaluate conflicting evidence.
exampleSentences.zh: 批判性思考使學生能夠評估相互矛盾的證據。

thinking.mnemonicHint: think 加 ing，思考正在進行

exampleSentences.en: Our dentist's office is on the third floor.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們的牙醫診所在三樓。

exampleSentences.en: The third experiment produced results consistent with the original hypothesis.
exampleSentences.zh: 第三次實驗所得的結果與原始假說一致。

third.mnemonicHint: three 的序數形式是 third

exampleSentences.en: Our mechanic performed a thorough inspection before the road trip.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們的技師在公路旅行前做了徹底檢查。

exampleSentences.en: Because the audit was thorough, even minor accounting discrepancies were detected.
exampleSentences.zh: 由於稽核十分詳盡，連細微的會計差異也被查出。

thorough.mnemonicHint: thorough 有「從頭查到尾、不漏角落」的感覺；記住 thorough inspection 是徹底檢查，而 through 是穿過、though 是雖然。

exampleSentences.en: Extra locks thwarted the burglar's attempt to enter our garage.
exampleSentences.zh: 額外的鎖使竊賊闖入車庫的企圖落空。

exampleSentences.en: Transparent procedures can thwart attempts to manipulate the allocation of public funds.
exampleSentences.zh: 透明的程序可以阻止操弄公共資金分配的企圖。

thwart.mnemonicHint: 把 thwart 聯想成一道橫著擋路的木板，使計畫過不去；它不只是延遲，而是讓某人的企圖受阻或失敗。

exampleSentences.en: Maya hopes to be a paramedic after she graduates.
exampleSentences.zh: Maya 希望畢業後成為救護技術員。

exampleSentences.en: The evidence appears to be consistent with the proposed hypothesis.
exampleSentences.zh: 證據似乎與所提出的假設一致。

to be.mnemonicHint: to + be 是不定詞，be 會依主詞和時態變成 am/is/are/was/were；把它視為「要成為或處於某狀態」的基本骨架。

exampleSentences.en: Local athletes meet every morning to strive for better personal records.
exampleSentences.zh: 當地運動員每天早上集合，努力爭取更好的個人紀錄。

exampleSentences.en: To strive for accuracy, researchers must disclose assumptions and replicate key measurements.
exampleSentences.zh: 為追求準確性，研究人員必須揭露假設並重複關鍵測量。

to strive.mnemonicHint: strive 是持續用力追求目標；不定詞 to strive 表示「去努力」。可連結 strove（過去式）與 striven（過去分詞），不要和 thrive「蓬勃發展」混淆。

exampleSentences.en: Please add some lemon to that cup of tea.
exampleSentences.zh: 請在那杯茶裡加一些檸檬。

exampleSentences.en: The committee objected strongly to that interpretation of the survey results.
exampleSentences.zh: 委員會強烈反對那種對調查結果的解讀。

to that.mnemonicHint: to 表示方向或關聯，that 指已提過的事物；兩者合用必須接在動詞或名詞後，不能當成獨立單字，例如 object to that interpretation（反對那種解讀）。

exampleSentences.en: This is the address to which you should send the package.
exampleSentences.zh: 這就是你應該寄送包裹的地址。

exampleSentences.en: Researchers identified the conditions to which the organism was most sensitive.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究人員找出了該生物最敏感的環境條件。

to which.mnemonicHint: to 提到關係方向，which 回指前面的名詞；正式關係子句把介系詞提前形成 to which，口語則常說 which ... to。它不是完整句子，需搭配先行詞與子句。

exampleSentences.en: We ran to the platform but missed the last train.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們跑向月台，卻錯過了末班火車。

exampleSentences.en: The researchers used labeled images to train the recognition model.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究人員使用已標記的影像來訓練辨識模型。

train.mnemonicHint: 一節節 train 像訓練步驟連起來

exampleSentences.en: The government pledged to be more transparent about spending.
exampleSentences.zh: 政府承諾在支出方面更加透明。

exampleSentences.en: Transparent algorithms are essential for accountable AI systems.
exampleSentences.zh: 透明的演算法對負責任的AI系統至關重要。

transparent.mnemonicHint: trans(through) + par(appear) + ent → 能看穿的 → 透明的

exampleSentences.en: She stored the treasurable family letters in a fireproof box.
exampleSentences.zh: 她把那些值得珍藏的家書收藏在防火箱裡。

exampleSentences.en: The archivist considered the diary treasurable because no other firsthand account had survived.
exampleSentences.zh: 由於沒有其他第一手紀錄留存，檔案管理員認為這本日記值得珍藏。

treasurable.mnemonicHint: treasure（珍寶、珍藏）加 -able（值得……的）就是「值得珍藏的」。此字正確但較罕見；日常英文通常用 precious 或 treasured，別誤寫成 treasureable。

exampleSentences.en: Burnt toast triggered the smoke alarm this morning.
exampleSentences.zh: 今天早上烤焦的吐司觸發了煙霧警報器。

exampleSentences.en: The stimulus triggered a measurable change in neural activity.
exampleSentences.zh: 該刺激引發了可測量的神經活動變化。

triggered.mnemonicHint: 扣 trigger 扳機就觸發事件

exampleSentences.en: Maya turned down the music when her baby fell asleep.
exampleSentences.zh: 寶寶睡著後，瑪雅把音樂音量調低了。

exampleSentences.en: Several qualified applicants were turned down because the program had limited funding.
exampleSentences.zh: 由於該計畫經費有限，數名合格申請者遭到拒絕。

turned down.mnemonicHint: turn down 可把東西「往下轉」而調低音量，也可把提議「往下壓」而拒絕；turned down 是其過去式或過去分詞，需依受詞判斷是哪個意思。

exampleSentences.en: Leo turns off the kitchen light before going to bed.
exampleSentences.zh: 里歐睡前會關掉廚房的燈。

exampleSentences.en: The indicator turns red when the solution reaches the target acidity.
exampleSentences.zh: 當溶液達到目標酸度時，指示劑會變紅。

turns.mnemonicHint: turn 加 s，表示多次轉彎或輪替

exampleSentences.en: What type of music do you listen to while cooking?
exampleSentences.zh: 你做飯時會聽哪一類音樂？

exampleSentences.en: This type of bacteria can survive in extremely dry environments.
exampleSentences.zh: 這類細菌能在極度乾燥的環境中存活。

type.mnemonicHint: type 可把事物分成類型，也可指用鍵盤把字打出來。

exampleSentences.en: The shop sells several types of tea.
exampleSentences.zh: 這家店販售好幾種茶。

exampleSentences.en: Different cell types perform specialized biological functions.
exampleSentences.zh: 不同細胞類型執行專門的生物功能。

types.mnemonicHint: type 加 s，表示多種類型。

glosses.measurable: 可測量的；可量化的；明顯到足以衡量的
glosses.striven: 努力過；力求過（strive 的過…
